## Oulbaene Mindspeaker (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
Male oulbaene bard 5  
LN Small monstrous humanoid  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +8  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 17 [22 vs. rays], flat-footed 12 (+1 armor [+5 vs. rays], +5 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)  
**hp** 107 (8 HD; 3d10+5d8+29)  
**Fort** +5, **Ref** +12, **Will** +7; +4 vs. bardic performance, language-dependent, and sonic  
**Immune** mind-affecting effects  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 20 ft.  
**Melee** 2 masterwork sickles +14/+9 (1d4), 2 tentacles +10 touch (1d6 acid plus revolting touch)  
**Ranged** 2 light revolvers +12/+7 (1d4/x4)  
**Special Attacks** bardic performance 16 rounds/day (countersong, distraction, fascinate, inspire competence +2, inspire courage +2), revolting touch (DC 14)  
**Bard Spells Known** (CL 5th; concentration +9)  

 2nd—alter self, distressing tone (DC 16), invisibility  
1st—cure light wounds, expeditious retreat, grease (DC 15), invisibility alarm  
0 (at will)—dancing lights, detect magic, mage hand, open/close, prestidigitation, read magic  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** An oulbaene mindspeaker calls for aid from his guards before casting distressing tone to sicken as many opponents as possible. Thereafter, he relies on his Multiattack feat and revolting touch to nauseate anyone sickened by his spell or wields his wand of oneiric horror to impede anyone trying to close on him.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 11, **Dex** 20, **Con** 16, **Int** 10, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +10; **CMD** 21 (25 vs. disarm)  
**Feats** [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Multiattack, Nimble Moves, [Weapon Focus (sickle)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Agile Maneuvers and Weapon Finesse are one feat, Weapon Finesse; in their place: Weapon Focus (sickle).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +15, Bluff +12, Climb +14, Diplomacy +12, Intimidate +8, Knowledge (arcana) +6, Knowledge (geography) +6, Knowledge (history) +6, Knowledge (local) +8, Knowledge (nobility) +6, Perception +8, Perform (oratory) +12, Sense Motive +6, Spellcraft +5, Stealth +15, Swim +15; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Acrobatics, +4 Perception  
**Languages** Aquan, Common, Oulbaene; telepathy 30 ft.  
**SQ** amphibious, bardic knowledge +2, lore master 1/day, multilimbed, versatile performance (oratory)  
**Combat Gear** potion of cure moderate wounds, wand of oneiric horror (32); **Other Gear** masterwork green scatterlight suit, masterwork sickles (2), 2 light revolvers with 12 metal cartridges each, 6 gp
